title: senecio scopolii subsp. floccosus
intro: Senecio scopolii subsp. floccosus, commonly known as Ragwort, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Senecio scopolii subsp. floccosus include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its ability to relieve symptoms such as pain, coughing, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
